menu_option_descriptions.billing: Configure the billing period, meter readings, advances and aggregate high/low tariff prices.
menu_option_descriptions.contract: Store supplier, product, distribution tariff, breaker and contract validity in confirmed history.

billing.title: Billing and electricity prices
billing.description: Configure the billing period, cumulative meter baselines, advances and prices. Initial high- and low-tariff values must be cumulative meter readings, not consumption for the period.

contract.title: Contract and tariff profile
contract.description: Enter the values exactly as shown in the contract or price list. Saving creates a new historical version; older contracts are not overwritten. Only an explicitly confirmed version may become active.

data.contract_confirm: I confirm these values match my contract

error.baseline_after_cycle_start: The baseline reading date must not be after the billing period start.
error.settlement_before_cycle_start: The settlement date must not be before the billing period start.
error.advance_outside_cycle: The advance start date must be within the billing period.
error.advance_end_before_start: The advance end date must not be before its start date.
error.replacement_outside_cycle: The replacement date must be within the billing period.
error.old_meter_vt_below_start: The old meter final high-tariff reading must not be below its initial reading.
error.old_meter_nt_below_start: The old meter final low-tariff reading must not be below its initial reading.
error.new_meter_start_negative: The new meter initial readings must not be negative.
error.contract_confirmation_required: Confirm that the values match your contract before saving.
error.invalid_contract: The contract values are invalid. Check the product, contract type, Dxxd tariff, breaker and validity/fixation dates.
